bootstrap.blocks: 100 iterations per npz; values shape (100,7,2); paired delta shape (100,6,2)
bootstrap.ci_rule: fixed original K; any invalid replicate makes ordinary CI NA; conditional valid-only intervals explicitly separate
bootstrap.draws: revision/bootstrap/draws.npz; 2000x1396 component draws and multiplicities; seed20261008, same draws for all models and both subsets

certificates: each DONE records hashes of completed files; verify before skipping; final DONE hashes inventory, manifest and checksum list
data/dev.npz: train and val only, ID/group/label arrays and class order; no test labels
encoding: UTF-8; TSV has one header line; JSON null/TSV NA denotes undefined, never zero-filled
features: train-fit definitions and parameters; scipy CSR npz or dense numpy npy. Float32 GPU copies are separately verified against canonical features. No role/source/evidence-level input features.
id_order: explicit protein_id arrays; columns follow frozen class_order.json
inventory: artifacts.tsv paths relative to output; bytes, SHA256, text physical line counts (header included); binary line count NA. Inventory excludes only artifacts.tsv, SHA256SUMS, manifest.json, DONE.json to avoid self-reference; includes REPORT_turn4.md and all cache/log/PID files.

labels.unknown_policy: masked in all fitting and metrics

model_storage.ensemble: candidate summary config.members/config.weights; fixed three-seed means use numpy mean after stacking, as inference_v2.py
model_storage.neural: gpu/<candidate>/best.pt; own torch 2.5.1 state dictionary plus config; last.pt retains optimizer and RNG for checkpoint audit

predictions.legacy: inference/val retained as pretest numerical-arithmetic diagnostic; never authoritative
predictions.tsv: revision/scores.tsv and predictions.tsv contain protein_id followed by fixed 32 classes; scores .17g roundtrip; index in revision/prediction_index.tsv
predictions.validation: inference_v2/val/final_predictions.npz reproduces candidate scores and decisions exactly

selection: selection/final_selection.json plus inference_runtime_v2.json, both frozen before test
